title: Molecular Graph-Based Deep Learning Algorithm Facilitates an Imaging-Based Strategy for Rapid Discovery of Small Molecules Modulating Biomolecular Condensates.
authors: Gao, Peng; Zhang, Qi; Keely, Devin; Cleveland, Don W; Ye, Yihong; Zheng, Wei; Shen, Min; Yu, Haiyang
one_liner_zh: 该文用图卷积网络筛选调控TDP-43相分离的小分子，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关蛋白，但核心是药物筛选而非TF-DNA结合建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Biomolecular condensates are proposed to cause diseases, such as cancer and neurodegeneration, by concentrating proteins at abnormal subcellular loci. Imaging-based compound screens have been used to identify small molecules that reverse or promote biomolecular condensates. However, limitations of conventional imaging-based methods restrict the screening scale. Here, we used a graph convolutional network (GCN)-based computational approach and identified small molecule candidates that reduce the nuclear liquid-liquid phase separation of TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43), an essential protein that undergoes phase transition in neurodegenerative diseases. We demonstrated that the GCN-based deep learning algorithm is suitable for spatial information extraction from the molecular graph. Thus, this is a promising method to identify small molecule candidates with novel scaffolds. Furthermore, we validated that these candidates do not affect the normal splicing function of TDP-43. Taken together, a combination of an imaging-based screen and a GCN-based deep learning method dramatically improves the speed and accuracy of the compound screen for biomolecular condensates.
abstract_zh: 生物分子凝聚体被认为通过将蛋白质浓缩在异常亚细胞位点而导致疾病，如癌症和神经退行性疾病。基于成像的化合物筛选已被用于识别能够逆转或促进生物分子凝聚体的小分子。然而，传统基于成像方法的局限性限制了筛选规模。在此，我们采用基于图卷积网络（GCN）的计算方法，识别出能够减少TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）核内液-液相分离的小分子候选物，TDP-43是一种在神经退行性疾病中发生相变的关键蛋白。我们证明了基于GCN的深度学习算法适用于从分子图中提取空间信息。因此，这是一种识别具有新型骨架小分子候选物的有前景方法。此外，我们验证了这些候选物不影响TDP-43的正常剪接功能。综上，基于成像的筛选与基于GCN的深度学习方法的结合，显著提高了生物分子凝聚体化合物筛选的速度和准确性。
